type: Actual local curated browser development recording

stages.text: ContractLens turns API promises into repeatable checks. A normal reservation can pass while retries quietly consume stock. This is the working local fixture lab, with curated cases and no model call.
The structured contract defines six promises, including safe retries and exact integer pricing. Every case starts with five units and a fresh ledger. Expected results come from this contract.

Nine authored cases pass validation. The external target proposal is rejected and never executed. The source badge explicitly says curated. Real NVIDIA generation through Nebius still needs verification.
Run the buggy fixture. One normal reservation passes, but eight contract checks fail. These are actual handler results: sixty four assertions, with requests, responses and state evidence.
Inspect the identical retry. Both requests use the same key. Stock falls from five to three, then from three to one. The replay created a second reservation instead of returning the first result.
Apply repairs and rerun the same accepted plan. This selects the authored repaired implementation; a model does not write a repair. All nine cases pass, and eight previous failures are resolved.

The repaired replay returns the original response. Stock stays at three and the ledger contains one reservation. The evidence shows both implementations, so a passing status alone cannot hide the state change.
Integer pricing catches another small but real defect. Three items at twenty nine cents must cost eighty seven cents. The buggy fixture returned eighty six; the repaired fixture returns eighty seven.

Export downloads the actual contract, curated source, accepted plan, both runs and comparison. This prototype audits one controlled API. Live Nebius and NVIDIA evidence, free judge access and the final submission video remain pending.

contract.name: Stock Reservation API
contract.description: Reserve a limited stock item without overselling, double-counting retries, or losing a cent.

headers.Idempotency-Key: A non-empty unique key for this logical request

body.quantity: A positive integer, at most the available stock

invariants.name: One reservation, one stock change
invariants.rule: A valid request returns 201 and deducts exactly the requested quantity once.

invariants.name: Reject invalid quantities
invariants.rule: Zero, negative, fractional, string, boolean and null quantities return 400 / INVALID_QUANTITY without changing stock or creating a reservation.

invariants.name: Never oversell
invariants.rule: A quantity above available stock returns 409 / INSUFFICIENT_STOCK with no state change.

invariants.name: Retries are safe
invariants.rule: The same key and identical body return the original 201 response; the replay makes no extra reservation and no stock change.

invariants.name: A key cannot change meaning
invariants.rule: Reusing a key with a different body returns 409 / IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT and does not change stock.

invariants.name: Every cent is exact
invariants.rule: A valid reservation has integer totalCents equal to quantity Ã— unitPriceCents, with currency USD.

contract.scope: Each case starts from five units and a fresh ledger. Requests execute only against embedded fixtures, never a supplied URL.

repairs.title: Validate quantity before changing state
repairs.detail: Require a positive integer. Reject invalid input with 400, preserving the ledger.

repairs.title: Check stock before reservation
repairs.detail: Return 409 when the requested quantity exceeds available stock.

repairs.title: Remember the meaning of each key
repairs.detail: Return the original response for identical retries and reject conflicting payloads.

repairs.title: Calculate prices in integer cents
repairs.detail: Multiply unitPriceCents by quantity; avoid truncating floating-point dollar arithmetic.

accepted.title: A normal reservation changes stock once
Zero should not silently become one
Negative quantities must not create stock
Half a unit is not a valid reservation
A numeric string is still the wrong type
Six requests cannot consume five units
A network retry must not reserve twice
The same key cannot describe a new order

rejected.title: Reject a proposal that targets an external API
rejected.reason: Only POST /v1/reservations on the embedded fixture is allowed. External URLs and other endpoints are rejected.
